news.headline:

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Ather Energy allotted 2,27,882 equity shares of face value INR 1 each under its ESOP 2025 Plan.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Asahi Songwon Q2 revenue surged 66.6% to ₹201.4 crore, with PAT jumping to ₹14.9 crore from ₹2.1 crore.

The company acquired the remaining 22% stake in Atlas Life Sciences, making it a 100% subsidiary.

Source: ScoutQuest
